---
title: "Personal Visualization Journey"
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse) 
workout_log = read.csv("Workout Log.csv")
```

```{r}
workout_log |>
  ggplot(aes(y = Weight, x = Reps, color = Exercise)) +
  geom_point()
```

```{r}
workout_log |>
  ggplot(aes(y = Weight, x = Reps)) +
  geom_point()
```
